modes.description: The modes the menu offers, the first the default: dm (deathmatch: everyone for themselves), ctf (capture the flag: Red against Blue).

deathmatch.description: Deathmatch: the first to so many kills wins the round, or whoever leads when time runs out.

timeLimitMs.description: How long a round lasts, in ms.

breakMs.description: How long the scores stay up after a round, before the next starts, in ms.

suddenDeath.description: When time runs out with nobody ahead: true, the next kill (or capture) wins and the floor crumbles away; false, the round is a draw.

crumblePerSecond.description: In sudden death: floor cells crumbled away each second.

respawn.description: Coming back after you're taken out.

delayMs.description: How long until you respawn, in ms.

protectionMs.description: How long nothing can hurt you after you spawn (until you fire), in ms.

armorShare.description: The share of damage armor takes, while it lasts: 0 (none) to 1 (all).

selfBlast.description: The share of its damage your own blast does you.

friendlyFire.description: Whether teammates can hurt each other (capture the flag).

voidCreditMs.description: Falling into the void is a kill for whoever hurt you this recently, in ms.

medals.description: What counts as what, for medals and sprees.

multiKillMs.description: Kills this close together add up to a multi kill, in ms.

assistMs.description: Hurting someone this soon before someone else kills them is an assist, in ms.

spree.description: Kills without dying that make a killing spree.

ctf.description: Capture the flag: Red against Blue; bring the other team's flag to your own, while yours is at home.

timeLimitMs.description: How long a round lasts, in ms.

flagReach.description: How close you have to get to a flag to take it (or send yours home), in metres.

flagReturnMs.description: A dropped flag goes home by itself after this long, in ms.

weaponsStay.description: Whether weapons stay on their pads when taken.

defendRange.description: Killing someone this close to your flag is a Defender medal, in metres.
